newsitem.title: USA: Chemed says expects expansion in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Chemed says expects expansion in 1997.

text.p: Chemed Corp said Thursday it sees continued expansion and progress in 1997 through acquistion opportunities.

The company also said National Sanitary Supply Co, its 83 percent owned subsidiary, will no longer be impacted in comparisions beginning the second quarter by the loss of a large food-service customer last year. Information on the name of that customer was not immediately available.
The company said it could make that prediction because National acquired in its first quarter A-Z Supply Co, its Chicago business partner.
The company also said Patient Care, its home healthcare subsidiary, expects to continue its expansion through strategic acquistions and expects progress in 1997.
